summary: The change consults the persisted ledger capacity wait only when the preparation outcome is progress; deferred, blocked, state_error, and other outcomes now derive their key from the current outcome. Added unit coverage checks the stale wait against several current outcomes, and the planner-level test reproduces an expired ledger capacity wait with an active GitHub cooldown and expects the cooldown key.

evidence: src/host/matrix-plan-diagnostic.ts lines 93-97 scope the ledger_capacity wait lookup to progress outcomes, so stale waits no longer replace deferred, blocked, state_error, or other classifications.

tests/host/matrix-plan-diagnostic_test.ts lines 202-227 exercise a persisted ledger_capacity wait with deferred reasons such as cutoff, artifact, cooldown, and admission, plus blocked, state_error, and unknown outcomes.
tests/host/matrix-plan-diagnostic-line_test.ts lines 363-431 reproduce an expired ledger_capacity wait and assert the current GitHub cooldown is reported while the stale wait remains persisted.
